name: Does a week of buyer-led flow pick next week's winners

history.reason: KILL, rejected with Luke's say-so (2026-11-16). 234 Sunday closes 2020-09 to 2025-10: slope +0.17% a week per SD with past week and size controlled, P(> 0) 86% (90% needed); the top fifth beat the average coin by 0.52% a week (P 96%, above the 0.31% hurdle), but the rule needed both. As money the top fifth lost 38% after costs (drawdown -92%) while the average liquid altcoin lost 57% and BTC made 102%: a coin picker only, worth considering inside a rule that decides when to hold altcoins.
